name: sonarqube
description: Connects Claude Code to SonarQube or SonarCloud. Triage issues, check quality gates, inspect metrics, and drive a confirm-before-write fix workflow against your codebase. Bundles the fix-sonarqube-issues, lead-review, pre-pr-review, and reduce-duplication skills.

sonarqube_url.title: SonarQube URL
sonarqube_url.description: Base URL of your SonarQube server, or https://sonarcloud.io for SonarCloud.

sonarqube_token.title: SonarQube user token
sonarqube_token.description: Generate one under My Account > Security > Generate Token. It must be a User Token — a Project Analysis token or a badge token can upload analysis results but cannot read issues, metrics, or duplications, and will fail with HTTP 401.

sonarqube_organization.title: Organization key (SonarCloud only)
sonarqube_organization.description: Required by SonarCloud, ignored by self-hosted SonarQube. Leave empty if you are not on SonarCloud.

repo_root.title: Repository root override
repo_root.description: Optional. The directory the read_file / write_file / search tools are sandboxed to. Leave empty to use whichever project you launch Claude Code in, which is almost always what you want.
